pool.text: Emperor Fasilides selected the city of Gondar as his royal camp.
A Yemeni ambassador visited the palace and described it as stone and lime.
An agreement between the Empress and Mikael involved the marriage of his son.
Ras Mikael Sehul killed Iyoas and crowned Yohannes II.
Relatives of Ali II caused unrest in Gondar, prompting leaders to withdraw.
Priests and citizens protested when Emperor Sahle Dengel attempted to reduce church power.
Kassa Hailu took control of the town and asked nobles to accept him.
Tewodros ordered the Muslim inhabitants of the city to convert or leave.
The Mahdists entered the city and burnt all the churches.
General Achille Starace occupied Gondar without a fight.
British and Italian military fought in Gondar during the East African Campaign.
Land tax introduction attempts met with military opposition in Gondar and Tigray.
The EPRDF launched a military offensive codenamed Operation Tewodros against the government.
Gondar has seen a surge in violent crimes due to conflict.
The city remains under Ethiopian government control after intense fighting.
